{{Quote|Jedi Master Belth Allusis, seven dozen of the Order's finest Knights, and four thousand of the Republic's strongest soldiers dug in to defend the shield generators&hellip;or die trying.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural's holodocumentary about the Battle of Bothawui|audio=OrDieTrying-Timeline5.flac|<ref name="Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui|int=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui}}</ref>}}
'''Belth Allusis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A polite and selfless individual, Master Allusis was a respected member of the Council and was liked by his peers for his sharp wit and sense of humor. In [[3671 BBY]], Allusis was in charge of the Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and Jedi that [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|defended]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] against the overwhelming [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces. Although all of the Republic defenders, including Allusis, were [[Death/Legends|killed]], they managed to inflict heavy casualties upon the Sith, forcing them to retreat. Master Allusis' bravery was remembered for years to come and inspired Republic forces across the war-torn [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Allusis and his men fell, but not before the Imperials were driven to retreat.|Gnost-Dural|audio=AllusisAndHisMenFell-Timeline5.flac|<ref name="Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui" />}}
Belth Allusis was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]]<ref name="Timeline 5" /> and a prominent member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]<ref name="Journal" /> active during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the resurgent [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. Since the beginning of the war in [[3681 BBY]], the Empire had scored many victories, and eventually established its dominance in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In [[3671 BBY]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] turned their forces toward the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and attempted to seize control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. However, a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] lay in wait above the planet, and the Sith attack was [[First Battle of Bothawui|repelled]]. The Republic fleet was then pulled back from Bothawui, and only a small force led by Master Allusis remained behind to defend the planet against a possible Sith counterattack.<ref name="Timeline 5" />

The attack soon followed; Imperial [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruisers]] from all around the galaxy moved in to [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|capture]] Bothawui. However, the planet was protected by a high-powered [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]], which prevented the Sith from using [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] and forced them to initiate a ground assault instead. Soon, a fifty-thousand-strong force of Sith landed on the planet and attacked the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]], which were protected only by seven dozen of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] and four thousand Republic [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], all commanded by Allusis. Despite being greatly outnumbered, the Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] put up a valiant fight; for each Republic soldier [[Death/Legends|killed]], the Empire paid with ten lives. During the battle, Allusis and his men developed unorthodox tactics, which&mdash;combined with the Imperial [[Commander/Legends|commanders]]' decision to send all of their troops directly into the assault&mdash;resulted in so many Sith losses that the Empire was forced to call in reinforcements.<ref name="Timeline 5" />

[[File:Bothawui3.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The last stand of Belth Allusis]]
Eventually, however, most of the Republic defenders were killed, and only a handful of Jedi and soldiers remained. The survivors gathered near Master Allusis and prepared for a final stand. At that moment, the Imperial [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Zellos]] offered to spare Allusis if he and his forces surrendered. Drawing from [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Allusis and his soldiers refused the offer and fought to the last man. Although all of the Republic forces perished, the Empire had taken too many casualties and was forced to retreat from Bothawui.<ref name="Timeline 5" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Allusis was a great Jedi who sacrificed himself at the Battle of Bothawui. The Republic honors his memory, but the Mandalorians are disgracing it.|[[Satele Shan]]|<ref name="TOR:IFMR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|[INTRO] Flashpoint: Mandalorian Raiders|Carrick Station}}</ref>}}
The last stand of "The Heroes of Bothawui"&mdash;as Allusis and his men became known&mdash;restored hope across the Republic<ref name="News">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20091023_001|text=The Battle of Bothawui|nolive=1}}</ref> and served as a turning point in the war. The strategies developed by them helped the Republic to temporarily hold off the Sith advancement,<ref name="Timeline 5" /> until the Sith allied with the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] [[3667 BBY|four years later]].<ref name="Timeline 4">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy|int=Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy}}</ref> The Republic was eventually defeated and forced to sign the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] with the enemy.<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> In the aftermath of its signing, the [[Lore Keeper|keeper]] of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]], [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] Jedi Master [[Gnost-Dural]], documented the Battle of Bothawui in a [[Holodocumentary|holorecord]],<ref name="Timeline 5" /> as well as his personal journal. [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] later compiled key entries from that journal into the book titled ''[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural]]'', adding her own recollections of Allusis.<ref name="Journal" /> To honor Allusis's bravery, a Republic [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] was christened after him, the ''[[Allusis]]''.<ref name="TOR:IFMR" />

After the Treaty of Coruscant, the Republic and the Sith Empire entered a period of [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During that period, the Mandalorian [[Clan Varad]], led by [[Mavrix Varad]], rebelled against the Sith-allied [[Mandalore the Vindicated]]'s rule and seized the ''Allusis'', using it to terrorize vulnerable worlds in the Outer Rim Territories. This prompted both the Republic and the Empire to send boarding parties to [[Battle for the Allusis|capture]] the ship. Ultimately, Clan Varad was defeated and Mavrix Varad was slain.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Flashpoint: Mandalorian Riaders}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|He was always a champion of lost causes, and though few knew it, he had an amazing wit. He could always be counted on to bring a touch of humor to even the most difficult discussions in the Jedi Council chamber.|Satele Shan, on Belth Allusis|<ref name="Journal" />}}
[[File:Belth_Allusis_JMGD.jpg|thumb|250px|Belth Allusis in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant]]
Belth Allusis was a courageous and selfless person, who was willing to defend Bothawui at all costs, even if it meant sacrificing his own life and the lives of his comrades. According to Gnost-Dural, Allusis's refusal to surrender was guided by the Force and was not driven by pride.<ref name="Timeline 5" /> Belth Allusis was noted for his sharp wit and sense of humor, often lightening up Jedi Council debates.<ref name="Journal" /> He was very polite in his behavior and humble in his clothing and was generally considered to embody the virtues of the Jedi Order.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> In ''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'', Satele Shan described Allusis as a champion of lost causes. As such, she was unsurprised by his decision to remain on Bothawui.<ref name="Journal" /> The bravery of Master Allusis and his fellow defenders of Bothawui was remembered in many years to come and was regarded as being the key factor in restoring hope of the Republic forces and rallying them to fight the enemy with renewed courage.<ref name="News" /> Master Allusis had [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and light skin.<ref name="Timeline 5" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Neither pride nor foolhardiness drove the defenders' decision. They were guided by the Force. They had passed beyond the fear of death. Their glorious last stand will never be forgotten.|Gnost-Dural|audio=GloriousLastStand-Timeline5.flac|<ref name="Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui" />}}
Belth Allusis was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual, who trained with the Jedi Order around the time of the Great Galactic War, and by 3671 BBY he had risen to the rank of Jedi Master. He was put in command of all of the Republic forces on Bothawui, with whom he created and employed several unorthodox tactics, resulting in heavy Sith losses during the battle.<ref name="Timeline 5" /> At one point, Allusis utilized a blue-colored [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> During the battle on Bothawui, however, he wielded a yellow-bladed one.<ref name="Timeline 5" />

==Behind the scenes==
Belth Allusis appeared in the [[Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui|fifth]] and the [[Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|sixth installment]] of the ''[[Galactic Timeline]]'', a series of videos that served as a tie-in to the massively multiplayer online role-playing [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The videos are presented as holorecords made by Jedi Master Gnost-Dural, who is portrayed by voice actor [[Lance Henriksen]].<ref name="Timeline 5" /><ref name="Timeline 6">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100122_001|text=Onslaught of the Sith Empire|nolive=1}}</ref>
